source_documents.title: X-Aggregation Enhanced Room Temperature Phosphorescence from Terphenylamine

reference_evidence_units.quote: The X-aggregation could enhance both the intermolecular charge transfer and the restriction on molecular motion, which shows promoting effects on the intersystem crossing processes and suppressed nonradiative decay, resulting in long-lived RTP emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA series
reference_evidence_units.statement: X-shaped dimers raise intermolecular CT (faster ISC) and suppress nonradiative decay.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The RTP lifetimes of o-TPA-sMeo, o-TPA-sMem, and o-TPA-sMep were 64 ms, 239 ms, and 209 ms, respectively (Figure 2c and Table S1).
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-sMeo, o-TPA-sMep

reference_evidence_units.quote: Their phosphorescence quantum yields (PQY) were 0.19%, 0.17%, and 2.0%, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-sMeo, o-TPA-sMep

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results demonstrated that the afterglow emitted from these TPAs was RTP rather than TADF.
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-sMeo, o-TPA-sMem, o-TPA-sMep
reference_evidence_units.statement: The afterglow is phosphorescence, not TADF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: As the electron cloud density on the N atoms increased, due to the Coulomb repulsion, the molecules of o-TPA-sMem, o-TPA-sMep, and oTPA-Me tended to form X-aggregates.
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-sMep
reference_evidence_units.statement: More electron-rich NH2 groups give X-shaped dimers in the crystal.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This further demonstrated that o-TPA-sMep preferred to aggregate via a nearly vertical conformation.
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-sMep
reference_evidence_units.statement: The para-methyl compound packs as nearly perpendicular (X) dimers.

reference_evidence_units.quote: When a bulkier tertbutyl group was introduced, the resultant o-TPA-tBu only displayed a fluorescence emission band of 380 nm, but did not exhibit any RTP emission (Figure S36).
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-tBu

reference_evidence_units.quote: both o-TPA-Me/OMe and oTPA-tBu adopted X-aggregation conformation
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-tBu

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results indicated that, after introduction of bulky groups, the resultant TPAs showed inefficient ISC behaviors.
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-tBu, methoxy analogues

reference_evidence_units.quote: unconstrained bulky groups would result in multiple conformations and disordered molecular arrangement
reference_evidence_units.subject: o-TPA-tBu
reference_evidence_units.statement: Rotating bulky groups give several conformations and disordered packing.
